import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
y = ok["actual_min"]
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
forest = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=50, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)

res = pd.DataFrame({"fact": y_test, "pred": forest.predict(X_test)})
res["err"] = res["fact"] - res["pred"]
res = res.join(ok["courier"])
big_share = round((res["err"].abs() > 10).mean(), 3)
err_by_courier = res.groupby("courier")["err"].mean().round(2)
worst_courier = res.loc[res["err"].abs().idxmax(), "courier"]
res['pred'] = res['pred'].iloc[::-1].to_numpy()

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour"]]
y = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
X_development, X_test, y_development, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
X_train, X_validation, y_train, y_validation = train_test_split(X_development, y_development, test_size=0.25, random_state=43)
train_scores, validation_scores = [], []
for depth in range(1, 11):
    model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=depth, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)
    train_scores.append(model.score(X_train, y_train))
    validation_scores.append(model.score(X_validation, y_validation))
best_depth = 1 + validation_scores.index(max(validation_scores))

import pandas as pd

from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour"]]
y = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
X_development, X_test, y_development, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
X_train, X_validation, y_train, y_validation = train_test_split(X_development, y_development, test_size=0.25, random_state=43)
y_test=~y_test
train_scores, validation_scores = [], []
for depth in range(1, 11):
    model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=depth, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)
    train_scores.append(model.score(X_train, y_train))
    validation_scores.append(model.score(X_validation, y_validation))
best_depth = 1 + validation_scores.index(max(validation_scores))
